name: Kiss My Chainsaw

features.name: Burnout
features.description: Two scatters on the same row trigger it.

features.name: The Ride
features.description: A 5x5 bonus with Charged Wilds up to 4x.

review:
Horror on 5x4 where scatters only land on reels 1, 3 and 5 – exactly two on the same row triggers Burnout. In The Ride, an extra row makes it 5x5, and Charged Wilds grow up to 4x before they're destroyed.

The Last Ride works the same way but guarantees a scatter on reel 5. xSplit shows up too. High volatility, 10,900x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
